name: observation_key
description: SHA-256 of series_id|metric_name|observation_date. Deterministic business key; the MERGE matches on this.

name: series_id
description: Logical series, e.g. SP500_COMPOSITE or CBOE_VIX. Clustering key.

name: metric_name
description: Measure within the series, e.g. close, index_level, cpi. Clustering key.

name: observation_date
description: Date the value refers to. Month-granularity feeds are normalized to the first of the month. Partitioning column.

name: metric_value
description: Observed value. NUMERIC rather than FLOAT64 to avoid binary float drift on monetary and index values.

name: source_name
description: Upstream feed that produced the row, for lineage.

name: batch_id
description: Ingestion batch that last wrote this row.

name: ingested_at
description: When the batch that last wrote this row was ingested.

name: updated_at
description: When this row was last inserted or changed. Unchanged by a no-op rerun.
